source.lapis_live_scope: Exact clean probe head used for the live P2 run; the later evidence-only commit does not alter probe inputs.

scope: P2 live probe of worktool exposure on Lapis's explicit-remote managed TUI, followed by two persistent threads, per-thread replay, response fail-close and mid-turn archive. It does not qualify embedded or local-daemon worktree creation.
checks: model observed no worktree tools or attachment
original pending request reconciled and answered after second archive
mid-turn archive disabled source and stale reply
non_claims: No managed worktree was created because the explicit-remote TUI did not expose its tools.
No worktree attachment, task-tool delegation, embedded/local-daemon worktree behavior, native input, GPU, package or Linux behavior is claimed.
The thread-switch contract is proposed, not implemented in Lapis.
A future Codex target that exposes worktree tools on explicit remote requires a new probe.

source_review.explicit_remote_target: AppServerTarget::Remote; app/startup.rs starts dynamic tool MCP only for LocalDaemon or Embedded targets.
source_review.managed_worktree_surface: Managed worktree tools and their create/poll/list schemas exist in the candidate, but the explicit-remote bridge is absent.
source_review.thread_archive: thread/archive can archive while a request and turn are active, emits thread/archived and resolves/cancels pending source requests.

finding.result: The P1/P4 qualified explicit-remote managed TUI does not expose managed worktree tools to the model.
finding.disposition: Recorded as a P2 boundary; no embedded or shared-daemon fallback was adopted.

thread_contract_proposal.selection: One Lapis observer remains bound to an explicitly selected persistent thread ID; it never adopts a second sender.
thread_contract_proposal.second_thread: A second persistent thread disconnects structured responses without killing the TUI/backend; pending decision tokens are rejected.
thread_contract_proposal.reconciliation: thread/resume then thread/read must be issued and checked per exact thread ID; each thread remains independently readable.
thread_contract_proposal.recovery: Archiving the foreign persistent thread allows explicit observer reconnection to restore the original pending request by typed ID and epoch.
thread_contract_proposal.archive: Archiving the selected thread during an active request disables responses, resolves/cancels source state and rejects stale replies.
thread_contract_proposal.future_switch: A UI switch must be explicit, select the target ID, increment the source epoch, reconcile target state and invalidate old decision tokens before responses re-enable.
